title: प्रयोगात्मक नेपाली शब्दकोशमा शब्दहरुको प्रयोग पक्षको अध्ययन {Prayogatmak Nepali Shabdakoshama Shabdaharuko Prayog Pakshako Adhyayan}
nepali: शोधशीर्षक ः 	प्रयोगात्मक नेपाली शब्दकोशमा शब्दहरूको प्रयोग पक्षको अध्ययन शोधार्थी ः 	दिनेश घिमिरे शोधनिर्देशक ः 	प्रा.डा. केदारप्रसाद शर्मा विभाग÷क्याम्पस ः 	नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभाग, विश्वविद्यालय क्याम्पस, त्रि.वि., कीर्तिपुर शैक्षिक वर्ष ः 	२०६१÷०६३ ः पृष्ठ संख्या ः ६१ + २०; अध्याय ः पाँच शोधप्रक्रिया ः प्रस्तुत शोधपत्र त्रिभुवन विश्वविालय शिक्षाशास्त्र सङ्काय नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभागअन्तर्गत एम.एड. नेपा.शि. ५९८ पाठ्यांशको प्रयोजनको लागि तयार गरिएको हो । अर्थ विधानका दृष्टिले प्रयोगात्मक नेपाली शब्दकोशको अध्ययन गर्ने, प्रनेशका विशेषताहरू पहिचान गर्ने, यसको प्रयोग पक्षको अध्ययन गर्ने, प्रनेशको प्रयोग पक्षको सबल र दुर्वल पक्षहरूको अध्ययन गर्ने जस्ता प्रमुख उद्देश्यमा यो शोधकार्य केन्द्रित रहेको छ । विशेषतः पुस्तकालय विधिलाई नै मूल रूपमा अवलम्बन गरिएको प्रस्तुत शोधपत्रमा प्राथमिक श्रोतको रूपमा प्रयोगात्मक नेपाली शब्दकोशबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरी उक्त सामग्रीको अध्ययन विश्लेषणका लागि वर्णनात्मक पद्धति र विश्लेषणात्मक पद्धतिलाई अँगालिएको छ । पाँच अध्यायमा संगठित शोधकार्यलाई क्रमशः शोधको सामान्य परिचय, शब्दकोशमा अर्थविधान, प्रयोग विधान र प्रयोगात्मक नेपाली शब्दकोश, प्रनेशका मुख्य विशेषताहरू, निष्कर्ष÷उपसंहार खण्डमा विभाजित गरिएको छ ।
american_english:
Research title: A Study of the Usage Aspect of Words in the Prayogatmak Nepali Shabdakosh
Researcher: Dinesh Ghimire
Research adviser: Prof. Dr. Kedar Prasad Sharma
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University Campus, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur
Academic year: 2061/063; number of pages: 61 + 20; chapters: five
Research procedure: The present research paper has been prepared for the purpose of the course Nepa. Shi. 598 of the M.Ed. under the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University.
This research work is centered on such main objectives as studying the Prayogatmak Nepali Shabdakosh from the point of view of meaning provision, identifying the features of the PrNSh, studying its usage aspect, and studying the strengths and weaknesses of the usage aspect of the PrNSh.
In the present research paper, which has basically adopted the library method in particular, material has been collected from the Prayogatmak Nepali Shabdakosh as the primary source, and the descriptive method and the analytical method have been embraced for the study and analysis of that material.
The research work, organized in five chapters, has been divided respectively into the sections: a general introduction to the research, meaning provision in the dictionary, usage provision and the Prayogatmak Nepali Shabdakosh, the main features of the PrNSh, and conclusion/epilogue.

How it was done: This research paper was put together for the Nepa. Shi. 598 course in the M.Ed. under the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University.

In this research paper, which pretty much takes the library method as its base, material was collected from the Prayogatmak Nepali Shabdakosh as the primary source, and the descriptive and analytical methods were used to go over and pick apart that material.
The research work, set out in five chapters, is split in turn into the sections: a general intro to the research, meaning provision in the dictionary, usage provision and the Prayogatmak Nepali Shabdakosh, the main features of the PrNSh, and the conclusion/wrap-up.
